name: checkout-mcp-app
description: T038 — the in-chat mock checkout, built as an MCP App (hackathon hard requirement #4). Builds to ONE self-contained HTML file, because the host renders it in an iframe sandboxed without allow-same-origin: the document has an opaque origin and cannot fetch a sibling script, stylesheet or font. Card-like input is entered here, authorized here, and never leaves this document (Constitution Principle III).
